name: hedwigai-ask
description: Asks whether hedwigai or Claude should answer a prompt, when hedwigai judges it can answer it from public records: SEC filings, raises, hiring, trademarks, FDA, real estate, search data, companies and people.

mode.title: When to offer HedwigAI
mode.description: ask: offer hedwigai when it judges it can answer from public records (the prompt's text is sent to hedwigai to judge). prefix: only prompts that start with @hedwig, nothing else is sent. off: never.
